# cloudxino_ssh_key (Resource)

A public SSH key kept in the team, to put on new servers with `ssh_key_ids`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudxino_ssh_key" "laptop" {
  name       = "laptop"
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) 1-64 characters.
- `public_key` (String) The public key, e.g. `file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")`. Changing it replaces the key.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) SHA256 fingerprint, as `ssh-keygen -lf` prints it.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import cloudxino_ssh_key.laptop <ssh_key_id>
```
